description: Phenotype expression reports. The three reports below are clearly labeled EXAMPLE TEMPLATES for contributors - they contain no real grower PII and their numbers are illustrative.

schema.strain: string, required - strain name matching strains.json
schema.grower: string, required for community reports - anonymous handle ONLY, never real names
schema.environment: object required - {type: indoor|outdoor|greenhouse, medium: soil|coco|hydro|living-soil, lights?: string, pot_liters?: number}

expressions.flower_weeks: number - weeks of flowering before harvest

schema.chem_results: object optional - {lab: string, source_id?: string matching sources.json, total_thc_pct?: number, total_cbd_pct?: number, dominant_terpenes?: string[], coa_url?: string}
schema.notes: string - freeform phenotype observations (avoid consumption/medical claims)

expressions.structure: bushy, tight internodes, strong main cola

reports.notes: EXAMPLE TEMPLATE - uniform pheno across 4 seeds, textbook NL structure, mild soil-fungus susceptibility in week 3. Illustrative numbers only.

expressions.structure: tall sativa, wide branching, long internodes
expressions.color: lime green with occasional magenta tips (cool nights)

reports.notes: EXAMPLE TEMPLATE - stretched aggressively outdoors; needed staking from week 6. No lab test performed. Illustrative numbers only.

expressions.structure: hybrid vigor, lateral spread, heavy resin

reports.notes: EXAMPLE TEMPLATE - 2 of 3 seeds showed similar chem; third was an outlier pheno (airier, lemon-forward). Illustrative numbers only.
